description: This file defines the class Vtiger_MailScannerRule, which encapsulates the logic for managing mail scanning rules within the vtiger CRM system. It includes properties for various rule criteria (such as from address, subject, body), methods for initializing rules from the database, matching email records against the criteria, updating/deleting rules, and executing associated actions.

classes.name: Vtiger_MailScannerRule
classes.description: Represents a mail scanner rule with criteria, actions, and database interaction methods to evaluate and manipulate email processing rules.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the rule instance by loading data from the database based on rule ID.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Provides a human-readable string summary of the rule criteria.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Loads rule data from the database for the given rule ID.

methods.name: initializeActions
methods.description: Loads associated actions for the rule from the database.

methods.name: hasBodyRule
methods.description: Checks if there is a body condition defined for the rule.

methods.name: isMatching
methods.description: Determines logical combination (AND/OR) of matching conditions.

methods.name: applyAll
methods.description: Applies all rule criteria to a mail record to check for a match.

methods.name: hasACondition
methods.description: Checks if at least one condition (from, to, subject, body) is set for the rule.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies a specific subrule condition to a mail record.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Checks if the input matches the search criteria based on the specified condition.

methods.name: __CreateMatchResult
methods.description: Creates a match result array for a subrule.

methods.name: __CreateDefaultMatchResult
methods.description: Creates a default match result indicating success based on match type.

methods.name: hasRegexMatch
methods.description: Checks if the match result contains a regex match and returns details if so.

methods.name: resetSequence
methods.description: Swaps the sequence order of two rules.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates or inserts the rule into the database.

methods.name: __nextsequence
methods.description: Retrieves the next sequence number for a new rule.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the rule and its associated actions from the database.

methods.name: updateAction
methods.description: Updates or deletes the action associated with this rule.

methods.name: takeAction
methods.description: Executes the associated action over a mail record when the rule matches.
